verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a 'self-improving database' workflow where agents review production Insights data and Schema Recommendations, then open pull requests on a recurring schedule. That workflow depends on external AI coding agents connected through its MCP server rather than a native automation engine. Separately, the product natively supports scheduled backups, which are a narrow form of background automation. Missing for 10: a native, user-configurable automation/scheduler for arbitrary tasks, documentation of where and how the recurring agent schedule is hosted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Agents can review production Insights data and Schema Recommendations, then open pull requests with performance improvements — on a recurring schedule.
Use the PlanetScale MCP server with AI coding agents to continuously optimize database performance based on production Insights data and Schema Recommendations
PlanetScale provides the ability to create, schedule, and restore backups for production and development database branches.
Use a PlanetScale service token to authenticate the hosted MCP server in CI, headless agents, and clients that send a custom HTTP header
